title: Africa–Asia petroleum gas exports
note: Petroleum gases and other gaseous hydrocarbons (HS 2711). This is the heading aggregate, including liquefied natural gas, other liquefied petroleum gases, and natural gas in the gaseous state. Reporter exports to the other region only. Values under USD 1 million are omitted. A missing pair is not zero trade. Customs weight is kilograms, not million Btu, and is not the Japan LNG price. Net weight and quantity can both be kilograms and still differ; they must not be substituted. A null net weight is not zero. Quantity 0 with unit code -1 is not a measured kilogram weight. This is not crude petroleum (HS 2709), not refined petroleum (HS 2710), and not coal (HS 2701). Marketed production is absent from this database, not zero. The Pink Sheet benchmark stored with this trade is liquefied natural gas, Japan, import price, c.i.f., in US dollars per million Btu. Recent two months are estimates. It is not the customs unit value. US Henry Hub, Europe TTF, and the natural-gas index are not stored.
